summary: Computer Space entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Computer Space
entries.definitive_edition: Original 1971 arcade cabinet, with 1973 two-player variant documented separately

emulation.emulator: Only if a documented recreation/emulation route is needed
emulation.notes: Prefer original cabinet access or museum-preservation documentation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original 1971 Nutting Associates Computer Space cabinet

primary.platform: Original arcade hardware / documented museum or preservation setup
primary.why: Computer Space is a discrete-logic arcade artifact rather than a normal software release. The archive target is a documented original cabinet or a rigorously identified preservation setup; casual ports or recreations should not be treated as the game itself.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original cabinet where possible. Record cabinet type, controls, monitor, board/revision, museum/location or owner, free-play/coin state, capture method, and whether the 1973 two-player version was separately documented.

secondary.why: It is a later hardware variant, not the 1971 single-player baseline.

secondary.exclusive_content: Access when cabinet hardware is unavailable
secondary.what_to_play: Use only with source and implementation notes.
secondary.why: The original cabinet is the real archive object.

entries.remaster_caveats: Treat software recreations as references unless their implementation and hardware assumptions are documented.
